not: dW fused update (separate dense::sgd_update_row path, not part of this dX snapshot)

training_step.status: training_step merged at 9d1f0cc6 (#666); fused forward + adam_dw + lazy q + qdot + fused backward + single-pass grad + single-pass Adam + Soft gate ordered-mask removal + train_step row fusion + Adam q sign threshold + q sign reuse in fused row/backward_step PR #668 (open, 84d4606b) + AVX2 dispatch hoist in forward_step (34th round, 6f168cd1)
training_step.operation: train_step: fused::forward_step per row quantizes and dots that row (forward_dot_row), computes y/diff/MSE immediately, then applies STE dW via dense::sgd_update_row and updates scale from the same row qdot; forward(): fused::forward_dot -> scale; train_step_with_grad: fused::backward_step once per row quantizes, accumulates dX/qdot, applies STE dW and updates scale; adam: fused::adam_step once per row quantizes, accumulates dX/qdot, updates latent/m/v; scale update stays in layer/adam.rs; old fused::backward + layer::adam_update is test-only; pack() is public inspection/comparison only; 34th round: forward_step detects AVX2 once at the whole-step entry, then step.rs runs the scalar or AVX2 row loop and calls dense::sgd_update_row_avx2 directly; no per-row has_avx2/target_feature dispatch

benchmark.timing_scope: end-to-end SGD train_step: fused quantize-dot forward + qdot reuse + dW + scale update; pack() excluded; q() lazy decode, layer construction and input generation excluded; release binary run directly
benchmark.pack_note: reference only; training/forward paths no longer call pack()

fused_forward.implementation: clamp(round(w/scale),-1,1) + sign-mask dot in one pass; same j mod 4 grouping and hsum as row_dot
fused_forward.note: SGD train_step 与 forward() 不再构造 pos/neg 双导轨；training uses fused::backward

fused_backward.implementation: one quantize pass produces 3 q masks; dX uses 4 accumulators grouped by r & 3; qdot uses 4 accumulators grouped by j mod 4; scalar tail matches input_grad order
fused_backward.note: train_step_with_grad 与 Adam 都不再 pack()；pack() 只保留公开检查/对拍

grad_step.implementation: one row scan quantizes q, accumulates dX/qdot, applies STE dW and updates scale; STE gate matches dense::sgd_update (positive w/s full lanes, Ste::backward tail); dX/qdot grouping matches fused::backward
grad_step.scalar_fallback_test: compares backward_step_scalar with input_grad_scalar / row_dot_scalar / update_row_scalar order
grad_step.note: 旧两遍为 fused::backward + dense::sgd_update；新单遍更新 latent/scale，dense::sgd_update_row 服务 train_step，dense::sgd_update 只在测试对拍编译

row_dot.accumulation_order: j mod 4 unchanged; bit-identical to the dynamic-index version
row_dot.note: 整步 A/B 是同轮交替的安静样本；row_dot 现在只服务 pack() 消费方与标量对拍

adam_step.implementation: one row scan quantizes q with w/s, accumulates dX grouped by r&3 and qdot grouped by j mod 4, updates latent/m/v; STE gate uses w*(1/s) matching old adam_update; scale update stays outside in layer/adam.rs
adam_step.scalar_fallback_test: compares adam_step_scalar with input_grad_scalar / row_dot_scalar / elementwise Adam
adam_step.note: 旧两遍为 fused::backward + layer::adam_update；新单遍不 pack()，旧路径只留测试对拍

soft_gate.kernel: Soft STE gate in dense::sgd_update / fused::backward_step / fused::adam_step (AVX2)
soft_gate.implementation: g = max(1 - ratio*ratio, 0) with 0 as the second maxps operand; when ratio is NaN, Intel maxps returns the second operand 0, matching scalar f32::max, so the cmp(ratio,ratio,ORD) + and ordered mask is removed
soft_gate.ab_context: same-round alternating; benchmark process high priority to avoid background load stealing cores
soft_gate.bit_exact: finite inputs unchanged; when ratio is NaN the gate returns 0 like the old ordered-mask lane; existing 38/38 tests pass
negative_candidates: q as float to reuse masks (slower)
SIMD scale update (no measurable gain; scalar loop already auto-vectorized)
Markstein reciprocal correction division (slower than divps)
soft_gate.note: Adam still dominated by the three divisions + sqrt in the m/v update, so its gain is smaller than the two SGD paths

q_sign.kernel: Adam q sign threshold in plane/fused/adam_step/q_sign.rs (AVX2)
q_sign.implementation: per row precompute half_s=0.5*s, neg_half_s and a +/-2^-12 relative band; per 8-lane block compare w>=half_s / w<=-half_s; only lanes inside the band or NaN fall back to the exact division quantization; dX/qdot accumulation order unchanged
q_sign.ab_context: same-round alternating; benchmark process high priority
q_sign.bit_exact: 6 scales x +/-8 ulp boundary lanes plus 64 random 8-lane blocks match scalar q sign; full Adam step vs old two-pass remains bitwise equal; cargo test 39/39
q_sign.note: q magnitude is not needed in Adam (qdot/dX consume only q>0/q<0); m/bias1, v/bias2 and the final division + sqrt are unchanged and remain the dominant cost

q_sign_reuse.kernel: q sign threshold reused in fused::row and fused::backward_step (AVX2)
q_sign_reuse.implementation: row/backward_step precompute half_s=0.5*s, -half_s and a +/-2^-12 relative band per row; per 8-lane block use q_sign::masks; lanes inside the band or NaN fall back to the exact division quantizer; dX/qdot accumulation order unchanged
q_sign_reuse.ab_context: same-round alternating; benchmark process high priority; both orderings measured for train/grad
q_sign_reuse.bit_exact: q sign boundary test compares masks to the old exact quantizer; fused/tests/threshold.rs checks fused::row against pack row_dot at the +/-0.5 boundary; existing 6-shape x 3-STE train/grad bitwise tests continue to pass; cargo test 40/40
q_sign_reuse.note: only the q quantization division is removed; forward MSE/STE and Adam m/v divisions are unchanged

forward_step.implementation: per row: forward_dot_row -> y/diff/loss -> dense::sgd_update_row -> scale update; no qdot/y/dy temporary vectors; forward_dot_row and sgd_update_row live in fused/row.rs and dense/row.rs
forward_step.ab_context: same-round alternating; benchmark process high priority
forward_step.bit_exact: 6 shapes x 3 STE x 3 steps: latent, scale and loss bitwise equal to the old two-pass path; cargo test 38/38
forward_step.note: old path was forward_dot (full latent scan) then dense::sgd_update (second scan); the per-row version keeps the row hot and removes three temporary allocations

limits: 本快照的 benchmark 只覆盖 dX = Wᵀdy；训练步读数见 training_step，两者不能互相替代。
dX 读数只覆盖 4096×576、单线程；不含 pack() 的量化成本。
训练步是单层单样本的端到端口径（SGD/Adam 都不含 pack，不含 q() 惰性解码），不含层构造/输入生成。

train_step 走 plane::fused::forward_step 的逐行融合（forward_dot_row 量化+点积、该行 MSE、dense::sgd_update_row 的 STE dW+scale，一遍且无 qdot/y/dy 临时向量）；forward() 走 plane::fused::forward_dot；train_step_with_grad 走 plane::fused::backward_step（量化 + dX + qdot + STE dW + scale 一遍，不 pack）；Adam 走 plane::fused::adam_step（量化 + dX + qdot + latent/m/v 一遍，不 pack），scale 在 layer/adam.rs 行外更新；pack() 只保留公开检查/对拍。
multi_shape 是单层、单样本的 SGD/Adam 矩阵；9x65 的绝对耗时只有 0.2–0.4 µs，倍数会抖，1x1 不计入证据。
row_dot 独立探针只测 4096 行、单线程；整步 A/B 是负载噪声下的同轮交替安静样本，不是 25 轮统计。
非 x86_64 或 cols < 8 自动回退标量；没有跨平台性能结论。
q() 首次调用才从双导轨解码并缓存；SGD train_step 不读 q，因此 q 内存只在消费者访问后出现。
没有多形状曲线、GPU/WASM 读数或实验录像；SGD/forward/with_grad/Adam 都不再 pack，pack() 仅公开参考。
浏览器 playground/WASM 不能执行该内核；前端只消费静态快照。
第三十四轮只把 AVX2 探测提到 SGD 整步入口，train_step 约 1.8%（5/9 快、4/9 平、0/9 慢）；shape_bench 中位差属噪声，不能写成 shape 加速；train_step_with_grad/Adam 不走该内核。
